title: Fix issue 2267: appsourcecop.json is not created for testapps
summary: Test and BCPT apps now generate appsourcecop.json files when code analyzers are enabled on test apps, preventing AS0054 compilation failures.
key_points: AppSourceCop analyzer was applied to test apps but configuration file wasn't created
New-AppSourceCopJson is now called for test app folders in addition to regular app folders
Resolves AS0054 errors when enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps setting is used
Compilation action in AL-Go workflow now handles test apps consistently
